mapper.sql: v.id, v.post_id, v.reason, v.title, v.summary, v.category_id, v.sub_category_id, v.thumbnail_url, v.thumbnail_mode, v.status, v.created_by, v.created_at, u.name AS creator_name, c.name AS category_name
